title: OB1 + SSW3 Status page does not show G5 transmitter information.
symptom: When using the new OB1 collector and in conjunction with a Sony Smartwatch 3, the status page in xdrip+ does not show any transmitter info. There are no battery stats, no firmware version, no temperature, etc. Shutting OB1 off restores this information.
fix: The issue was resolved in a nightly build; users confirmed that updating to the latest nightly fixed the problem.
evidence_quote: This should now be resolved, please try the latest nightly and let me know. Thanks
